# Crisis and Reputation

**First-hour runbook for when an AI account goes wrong: kill switch, evidence, holding statements, reports, post-mortem.**

Runs incident response for an AI influencer or agent account when something goes wrong in public — a wrong or harmful AI post, offensive output, a hacked account or leaked key, an impersonator or scam coin using the agent's name, "rug" or price-crash accusations, a deepfake, a sponsor problem or a platform strike. Gives severity levels, a minute-by-minute first-hour runbook (kill switch, evidence, escalation to the human team), approved holding statements, platform reporting paths, correction rules, a blameless post-mortem and a 30-day trust rebuild. Use when mentions spike negatively, a post needs pulling, an account is compromised, someone impersonates the agent, or a person asks "what do we say?".

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Grow](../README.md) | intermediate | first hour, then 30 min a day for a week | `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-08 |

## How it works

1. Stop every other poster
2. Capture evidence before touching anything
3. Open the incident log
4. Page the humans

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/crisis-and-reputation.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/crisis-and-reputation.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/crisis-and-reputation.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/crisis-and-reputation.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill crisis-and-reputation`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `crisis-and-reputation.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/crisis-and-reputation`.
